changes.title: Landing wait
items: Sailing to an island lands sooner: its forest is drawn while you look at it on the chart and fly in

changes.title: Leash round lakes
items: Your animals following you across the island walk round lakes along the shore, and their dotted trail shows the way they really go, instead of cutting straight over the water

changes.title: Soundsystem light
items: The light round a partying soundsystem no longer blows out to white: the ground stays lit and coloured with its grass showing
Pause page (Esc): sliders for the light's knee and ceiling, the soundsystem's light and the bloom threshold
